evidence.excerpt: Over long horizons, execution accuracy is a binding constraint: a change can silently leak held-out data, omit normalization, disconnect a gradient, or leave a train/eval flag unwired, invalidating expensive runs and compounding error across iterations.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a budget-matched evaluation, heterogeneous composition raises all-oracle execution accuracy from the best single-product baseline of 45.8 percent to 62.5 percent (paired +16.7 points, 95 percent CI [6.6, 26.7]) while achieving a 10.4 percent silent critical-defect rate.
